preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 20,000.
For each test case, the number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000, and the number of edges m must be between 1 and the minimum of 200,000 and the number of possible edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All vertices x and y in the edges must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to direct the edges to form a DAG, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by m lines of directed edges.

postconditions.expression: all(t == 1 for t, x, y in edges)
postconditions.description: All edges in the output must be directed.
The directed graph must not contain any cycles.
